title: Hello, Spring

sections.name: Listen
lines: Pink and yellow, row by row.
Hello, spring, the birds come back,
Tweet, tweet, tweet, along the track.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Open up for you and me.
Little seeds down in the ground,
Pop up, pop up, all around.

sections.name: Together
lines: Hello, spring, we sing with you,
Skies are bright and fresh and new.
Hello, spring, come out and play,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Red and orange, green and blue.
Bees are humming, hum, hum, hum,
Spring is here and spring is fun.

sections.name: All together
lines: Hello, spring, we wave to you,
Hello, spring, we love you so,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Hello, spring, the flowers grow,
Pink and yellow, row by row.
Hello, spring, the birds come back,
Tweet, tweet, tweet, along the track.

[Listen again]
Little buds on every tree,
Open up for you and me.
Little seeds down in the ground,
Pop up, pop up, all around.

[Together]
Hello, spring, we sing with you,
Skies are bright and fresh and new.
Hello, spring, come out and play,
Every flower says good day.

[One more verse]
Butterflies are dancing too,
Red and orange, green and blue.
Bees are humming, hum, hum, hum,
Spring is here and spring is fun.

[All together]
Hello, spring, we wave to you,
Hello, sunshine, hello, dew.
Hello, spring, we love you so,
Watch the happy flowers grow.

title: Mango Summer

sections.name: Together
lines: Summer song for you and me,

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Splash the water, cool and wet,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Hot, hot summer sun,
Mangoes for everyone.
Juicy, yellow, sweet,
Mango is a treat.

[Listen again]
Ice lolly, cold and pink,
Melting faster than you think.
Lick it, quick, quick, quick,
Sticky, sticky stick.

[Together]
Summer song for you and me,
Shady under the mango tree.
Fan goes round and round,
What a cooling sound.

[One more verse]
Splash the water, cool and wet,
Hottest day we've had yet.
Hat on, play outside,
Run and jump and hide.

[All together]
Hot, hot summer sun,
Mangoes, mangoes, every one.
Summer, summer, hooray,
Have a mango day!

title: Monsoon Clouds

sections.name: Listen
lines: Here comes rain, here we go.
Grey clouds rumble, boom, boom, boom,

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Drip, drop, on the window pane,

sections.name: Together
lines: Sing with me in the monsoon rain,
Splash and jump and splash again.
Keep us cosy, keep us dry.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Hot chai and a warm pakora,
Rain is singing, more, more, more-a.
Frogs are croaking, croak, croak, croak,

sections.name: All together
lines: Grey clouds rumble, now they go,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Grey clouds rumble, rumble low,
Here comes rain, here we go.
Grey clouds rumble, boom, boom, boom,
Rain is coming very soon.

[Listen again]
Drip, drop, on the window pane,
Pitter, patter, monsoon rain.
Paper boats go sailing by,
Under the big grey sky.

[Together]
Sing with me in the monsoon rain,
Splash and jump and splash again.
Umbrella up, umbrella high,
Keep us cosy, keep us dry.

[One more verse]
Hot chai and a warm pakora,
Rain is singing, more, more, more-a.
Frogs are croaking, croak, croak, croak,
Puddles big enough to soak.

[All together]
Grey clouds rumble, now they go,
Peeking sun says hello.
Monsoon, monsoon, thank you, rain,
See you next year again.

title: Rainbow Steps

sections.name: Listen
lines: Step on red and step on orange,
Up the rainbow, up we go.
Yellow, green, and blue and purple,
Up the rainbow, high, not low.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: C, D, E, and F and G,
Climb the rainbow, one, two, three.
G is at the very top,
Look how far, we cannot stop!

sections.name: Together
lines: Climb with me the rainbow stairs,
Up and up through sunny air.
Hold my hand and count each one,
Rainbow steps are so much fun.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: From the top, what can we see?
Clouds and birds and you and me.
Wave to Mummy, wave to Dad,

sections.name: All together
lines: Step on red and step on orange,
Rainbow colours, all in a row.
Five steps up and we are done,

lyrics:
[Listen]
Step on red and step on orange,
Up the rainbow, up we go.
Yellow, green, and blue and purple,
Up the rainbow, high, not low.

[Listen again]
C, D, E, and F and G,
Climb the rainbow, one, two, three.
G is at the very top,
Look how far, we cannot stop!

[Together]
Climb with me the rainbow stairs,
Up and up through sunny air.
Hold my hand and count each one,
Rainbow steps are so much fun.

[One more verse]
From the top, what can we see?
Clouds and birds and you and me.
Wave to Mummy, wave to Dad,
Best rainbow we ever had.

[All together]
Step on red and step on orange,
Rainbow colours, all in a row.
Five steps up and we are done,
Rainbow steps for everyone!

title: Windy Day
lyrics:
[Listen]
Whoosh goes the wind,
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.
Hats fly away,
Push, push, push.

[Listen again]
Leaves go spinning,
Round, round, round.
Swirling, twirling,
Up off the ground.

[Together]
Blow with me now,
Whoo, whoo, whoo.
Wind in my hair,
Wind in yours too.

[One more verse]
Washing on the line,
Flap, flap, flap.
Windows rattle,
Tap, tap, tap.

[All together]
Wind goes to sleep,
Shh, shh, shh.
Quiet and still,
Hush, hush, hush.

title: Falling Leaves

styles: three beats in a bar, drifting down

lyrics:
[Listen]
Leaves falling down,
Red, gold, brown.
Spinning so slow,
Down they go.

[Listen again]
Crunch under feet,
Crisp and neat.
Kick them up high,
Wave goodbye.

[Together]
Fall with the leaves,
Twirl and spin.
Down to the ground,
Then begin.

[One more verse]
Squirrel collects,
Nuts to store.
One, two, and three,
Then some more.

[All together]
Last leaf comes down,
Soft on the town.
Sleep, little tree,
Spring will be.

title: Winter Blanket
lyrics:
[Listen]
Cold winter night,
Blanket tight.
Warm little toes,
Cold little nose.

[Listen again]
Soft woolly hat,
Purring cat.
Hot milk to sip,
Sip, sip, sip.

[Together]
Snuggle with me,
One, two, three.
Under the sheet,
Warm and sweet.

[One more verse]
Fog on the glass,
Draw as we pass.
Write our names there,
Cold winter air.

[All together]
Cold winter night,
Hold me tight.
Blanket of love,
Stars above.

title: Little Snowman

sections.name: Listen
lines: Roll a snowball, big and round,
Roll it, roll it on the ground.
One for tummy, one for head,
Carrot nose, a scarf of red.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Two black buttons for his eyes,
Twig for arms that wave hello,

sections.name: Together
lines: Build with me, a snowy friend,
Round and round, from end to end.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: Landing on my nose, oh no!
Catch a snowflake on your tongue,

sections.name: All together
lines: Drip, drip, drip, what's that about?

lyrics:
[Listen]
Roll a snowball, big and round,
Roll it, roll it on the ground.
One for tummy, one for head,
Carrot nose, a scarf of red.

[Listen again]
Two black buttons for his eyes,
Little snowman, what a size!
Twig for arms that wave hello,
Standing in the mountain snow.

[Together]
Build with me, a snowy friend,
Round and round, from end to end.
Little snowman, cold and white,
Smiling in the morning light.

[One more verse]
Snowflakes falling, soft and slow,
Landing on my nose, oh no!
Catch a snowflake on your tongue,
Winter songs are being sung.

[All together]
Little snowman, sun is out,
Drip, drip, drip, what's that about?
Goodbye, snowman, see you soon,
Next winter, under the moon.

title: All Year Round

styles: children's choir with a warm adult voice

sections.name: Listen
lines: Spring has flowers, summer has sun,
Monsoon rain goes splash and pour,
All year round, there's music more.

sections.name: Listen again
lines: Red and gold all over town.
All year round, we sing tonight.

sections.name: Together
lines: Sing with me the seasons song,
Six little notes to play along.
C, D, E, and F and G,
All year round, for you and me.

sections.name: One more verse
lines: All year round, we love to play.

sections.name: All together
lines: Round and round the seasons go,
Fast and slow and high and low.
Thank you, year, for all you bring,
All year round, we sing, sing, sing!

lyrics:
[Listen]
Spring has flowers, summer has sun,
Mangoes juicy, one by one.
Monsoon rain goes splash and pour,
All year round, there's music more.

[Listen again]
Autumn leaves go spinning down,
Red and gold all over town.
Winter blankets, cosy and tight,
All year round, we sing tonight.

[Together]
Sing with me the seasons song,
Six little notes to play along.
C, D, E, and F and G,
All year round, for you and me.

[One more verse]
Windy days and rainbow skies,
Snowmen with their button eyes.
Every season, every day,
All year round, we love to play.

[All together]
Round and round the seasons go,
Fast and slow and high and low.
Thank you, year, for all you bring,
All year round, we sing, sing, sing!
